## My Research

My research focuses on developing advanced drug-delivery systems for the treatment and prevention of inner-ear diseases. I am particularly interested in nanoformulations, exosome-based drug delivery, lipid-based nanoparticles, and thermoresponsive hydrogels.


## Research Interests

- Nanomedicine and targeted drug delivery
- Inner-ear drug delivery
- Exosome-based formulations
- Polymeric and lipid-based nanoparticles
- Thermoresponsive hydrogels
- Three-dimensional cell-culture models
- Reproducible data analysis using R
